author: Nerdstalgic
description:
Breaking Bad is one of the greatest television dramas ever made, and its unforgettable characters are a huge reason why. From Walter White and Jesse Pinkman to the terrifying Gus Fring, Breaking Bad created some of television's most complex, memorable, and dangerous characters.

We take a deeper look at the world of Breaking Bad, exploring the villains, characters, and storytelling choices that helped make the series a modern classic.

Featuring:
00:00:00 - Why Gus Fring Was Breaking Bad's Most Terrifying Villain
00:08:23 - Why This Breaking Bad Character Almost Never Existed
00:17:09 - The Strange Disappearance Of The Anti-Hero

Whether you're revisiting Breaking Bad or discovering what made the series so influential in the first place, there's a lot more going on beneath the surface.
